controls.scope: Retained offline mocked controls inspected, not independently rerun; no actual remote workload qualification.

resolved_findings.subject: TimeoutExpired partial observer output
resolved_findings.resolution: Retains bounded 64 KiB text prefix per stream, full available byte count/hash and truncation flags; no claim of lossless full raw retention beyond that limit.

resolved_findings.subject: Launcher exit racing signal
resolved_findings.resolution: ProcessLookupError does not bypass subsequent fingerprinted own-container stop scan.

resolved_findings.subject: Closure execution-class and dataset arguments
resolved_findings.resolution: Checks process-cluster, repeat1, certificate mode/cap, graph500 family and canonical resolved dataset path in addition to source/resources/algorithm fields; negative controls cover mode/dataset/validation mismatch.

checks: All three reviewed configuration hashes match plan and pinned readiness dataset/canonical-edge metadata.

Configuration comparison with closed Pecan24 preserves runtime561, old3a controller/nativeffcf, process-cluster, source, direction, delta, parallelism, resource envelope and logging; namespace/scale/engine changes and longer deadlines are explicit.
8h algorithm and9h cell outer limit are distinct from additional15min launcher-overrun guard and observer duration; no exact whole-supervisor9h promise.
Each cell requires fresh namespace, pinned support inventory, runtime/native hashes, clean source, manifest and boot identity, no other running container, disk/RAM admission.
Runtime disk guard stops below8GiB, observer/interference/identity failure closes queue; polling is not a reservation and cannot exclude between-observation interference.
Only launcher-owned process group and configuration-fingerprinted containers are targeted by abort; no global Docker stop/prune or dataset/output deletion.
Wrapper exit0 does not qualify a failed producer. Both producer/result pass plus certificate, runtime/arguments, exit/OOM and cleanup evidence required for success.
Grenada25 requires actual qualified Grenada24 pass; completely collected independent non-pass can continue, while missing/malformed evidence or uncertain cleanup stops queue.
Producer/cell raw outcomes retained separately; physical Parquet output qualification remains pending and explicit.
limits: Read-only source/configuration/evidence review; no SSH, Docker, benchmark, new runtime test or remote admission was performed.
Manifest hashes establish recorded input identity; this review did not rehash remote Parquet payloads.
Pool/quota are per-process configuration, not proof of actual native reservation by Pecan or a cluster-wide memory/RSS bound.
Shared-host capacity/correctness preparation is not a measured speedup, dedicated-host timing result or multi-host scaling qualification.
No unconditional claim of successful cleanup if Docker/control plane is unavailable: stop error and retained lock require operator intervention.
